title: RAW UNREVIEWED: contraindication scopes a rejected treatment branch while preserving one recipient
summary: A medical account may introduce a recipient condition, forbid one action under that condition, and permit an alternative. A coherent reading must distinguish mentioned action from performed action and retain the recipient through both branches. Body/bath roles constrain administered object, recipient and surrounding medium separately.
required_falsifier: Reject if a prohibited action must execute to make later arguments available, if recipient changes without entry, if negative scope is supplied only by genre expectation, or any unaccounted wholeform forces a post-result branch exception.
exact_changed_research_decision: Decide whether a failed sequential-action account is better posed as an explicitly scoped contraindication rival; only a different prospective falsifier permits selection, with old sequential failures retained.

design.mechanism: Enter recipient R and written condition K; IF(K,R) scopes NOT_DO(A,R); ELSE or a separately written permission scopes DO(B,R). Both branch operators bind the same entered recipient; A and B retain their paid arguments. Negative scope cannot be reconstructed from a fluent translation.
independent_constraints: Explicit branch/negative boundary must exclude actual execution of the rejected action.
Recipient/body versus vessel/environment image roles are independently typed.
All exact-form frequencies, polarity-related compositions and entry-context profiles fit the same finite branch grammar on two complete cases.
design.unit: Two complete prospective admitted contexts plus their independently owned image-role evidence; no target nomination or access by producer.
design.minimum_adequate_test: First audit claim-bearing predecessors and known counterexample; then root can choose one paired exploratory whole reading and only freeze a test if a distinct consequence remains.
design.budget_note: Root must set total preparation/implementation/validation/publication budget in the selected existing proposal before substantial work; this raw producer launches no experiment.
